title: Halberd (Iron Spear)
description: Turns the iron spear into a halberd.
body:
## There are translations for:
English (US, UK, AU, NZ, CA)
Anglish
German / Deutsch (DE)

## Type of Halberd
It is a pollaxe, a halberd with a point, an axe blade, and a hammer.

## Does it change the game?
No, it is a retexture.

## Is it historically accurate?
Probably.
